name: application-settings-nav-list
title: Settings Nav List
description: Grouped vertical settings menu with section headers, icon-labeled items, and a highlighted active section.
useWhen: A settings or preferences area has enough pages to benefit from grouped categories (Account, Workspace, etc).
You want icons alongside labels to speed up scanning a long settings list.
The active section needs a clear, persistent visual indicator as the user moves between settings pages.
avoidWhen: There are only 2-3 settings pages — a simple tab bar is lighter weight than a grouped sidebar list.
The layout needs to collapse into icon-only or a drawer on mobile — extend this component with your own responsive wrapper.
Navigation targets other app sections, not settings sub-pages — use side-menu or dashboard-sidebar instead.
responsiveBehavior: The nav is a fixed w-56 column intended for a settings-page sidebar; collapse or hide it below your chosen mobile breakpoint.
accessibility: The active item carries aria-current="page", the correct token for identifying the current page in a navigation list.
Icons are aria-hidden since the visible text label is always present alongside them.
The nav is wrapped in a labeled <nav> landmark so screen reader users can jump directly to it.

variants.title: Settings nav list
variants.description: Two grouped sections (Account, Workspace) with icon-labeled items and 'Profile' highlighted as active.
accessibility: Active state is shown with both a background fill and font-weight change, not color alone.

variants.title: Settings nav list (Dark)
variants.description: Settings nav list adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Active background and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
